    Orthogonality and non-split classes for transports #

    Morphisms into or out of a glued module vanish when they vanish on the pieces (Bricks.hom_extFamily_eq_zero, Bricks.hom_to_extFamily_eq_zero). Hence a Kronecker module orthogonal to all pieces of an anchored family is orthogonal to every transport along it. A non-split class with quotient the anchor C extends to a non-split class with quotient any transport, through the copy of C inside the transport (Bricks.Anchored.exists_not_splits_transport).
